title: Jazzy Smoky Italian Butternut Squash Venetian Stew
description: Warm and comforting stew from the Venetian region of Italy, featuring roasted butternut squash, smoky confit tomatoes, and aromatic herbs.
instructions: Toss the cubed butternut squash with 2 tbsp olive oil, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet. Roast for 45 minutes, or until tender and lightly caramelized.
In a large Dutch oven, cook the chopped onion over medium heat until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the can of confit tomatoes, chopped basil, and dried thyme to the Dutch oven. Stir to combine.
Add the roasted butternut squash to the Dutch oven and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered, for 20-25 minutes, or until the flavors have melded together and the stew has reached your desired consistency.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with additional chopped basil if desired.
